messages.subject: Reproducible Examples
parts:
When using mailing lists or groups (like this one) for help, it is
important to attach reproducible examples.
For this purpose, I here is a link to Hadley Wickham (creator of
ggplot2 and other useful packages) giving some guidelines how to do
it.
Enjoy

http://gist.github.com/270442
